name: Urolithin A
summary: Urolithin A is a gut-microbiome-derived metabolite produced from ellagitannin and ellagic-acid precursors. Human randomized trials have tested supplemental urolithin A for mitochondrial and muscle outcomes, with signals for muscle endurance, strength, and mitochondrial biomarkers but inconsistent effects on primary functional endpoints.
description: Canonical urolithin A research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, funding, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site’s review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: mitophagy signaling; mitochondrial quality control; skeletal-muscle bioenergetics
